entities.name: Alejandro Rejón Huchin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wilberth Alejandro Rejon Huchin is a Mexican poet and cultural manager. He was a fellow at the 2016 interface cultural festival in Mérida. Director of the Tecoh international poetry festival, Yucatán. Some of his texts have been translated into Arabic, Italian and Romanian.
